programme.title: Incas: The Rise and Fall
programme.sub-title: The last ruler of the empire
programme.desc: The origins of the emergence of an advanced ancient civilization in South America.According to Inca mythology, the legendary founder of the Inca dynasty and the city of Cuzco is Manco Capac.An equally important figure was Pachacutec, one of the most distinguished rulers.It was during his reign that Machu Picchu was created.Thanks to conquests, reforms, revolutionizing architecture and infrastructure development, he transformed his kingdom into a powerful empire.He imposed a solar cult, establishing a sun festival.To maintain his power, he did not hesitate to perform human sacrifices After the conquistador Francisco Pizarro arrived in South America, the empire collapsed in less than ten years.The authors of the series will explain why the army of 30,000warriors could not defeat two hundred Spaniards.They will also present the tragic history of the last three rulers.The better-armed and tactically experienced newcomers from Europe were joined by rebellious peoples, which consequently led to the destruction of the legacy of the Sun's descendants.The fall of the Inca state will be shown in 3D - from Cuzco, Cajamarca, the Pacific coast to the Chilean desert.
